title: UiCopy
description: contracts/ui/copy.v1.json: user-facing strings shared by the dashboard, the static site and the docs (SPEC §3.3). A tree of snake_case keys whose leaves are strings or string lists. Placeholders use {name}; {command:<id>} renders a copyable command from ui/commands.v1.json and {claim:<id>} renders a value claim (display plus label chip) from claims/value-claims.v1.json.
